text:
incident-bot: PAGE: High 429s observed for org 'pixelforge' across eu-west-1 ingestion endpoints. Alert: org_qps_spike >= 95th percentile. Auto-escalation to on-call.
ryan-oncall: I'm on it — looking at dashboards now. How many 429s?
maya-sre: @ryan-oncall seeing sustained 429 rate ~18% over last 2m, p95 latency unchanged. Token drop indicates rate limiting at org quota layer. Customer reported failures for uploads.
customer-success-liz: PixelForge just DM'd support: "bulk import failing with 429s, blocking release" — they're blocking.
ryan-oncall: Ok priority = customer-impacting. Can we temp-increase their org quota and apply soft-throttle policy to reduce collateral?
ops-alex: I can apply an emergency RL bump now. Org id: org-86ff. Suggest increase from 100r/s -> 300r/s for 30m and enable per-user fair-share.
maya-sre: +1 to fair-share; avoid whole-cluster burst. Also put a soft reject for heavy rerank calls.
ops-alex: Running command:
```
# emergency rate-limit bump
redwoodctl org update --id org-86ff --org-qps 300 --duration 30m --tag emergency_pixelforge
```
ops-alex: Command output:
```
Applying org config... done
New org-qps=300 (was 100)
Fair-share hooks enabled
Schedule revert at +30m (id: schedule-7b2)
```
ryan-oncall: Confirmed via console: org-86ff qps=300, schedule set.
dev-exec: While we wait, recommend disabling vector-rerank for this org — most load is from /v1/rerank-batch. Can we toggle feature flag?
ops-alex: Toggling flag:
```
redwoodctl feature-flag set --org org-86ff --flag vector_rerank false
```
ops-alex: Flag update ack: vector_rerank=false for org-86ff
customer-success-liz: Let PixelForge know we applied a temporary quota bump and disabled rerank; share ETA 30m and offer rollback if regressions.
maya-sre: Monitoring: error rate dropped to 4% within 90s after actions; throughput normalized. Still watching latency and backend CPU.
ryan-oncall: Handing off to night on-call @eva-oncall — brief: emergency RL bump + rerank disabled, scheduled revert in 30m (schedule-7b2). Contact list: ops-alex, maya-sre, me.
eva-oncall: Ack takeover. I'll watch until revert and escalate if error rate creeps back above 5%.
ops-alex: Added temporary dashboard panel and slack alert: pixelforge_emergency_watch -> notify #incidents if 429 > 5% for 5m.
maya-sre: Runbook steps taken: 1) RL bump 100->300 2) enable fair-share 3) disable vector_rerank 4) schedule auto-revert 30m. Documenting incident in postmortem template.
customer-success-liz: PixelForge replied: "Thanks — importing resumed. Please keep us posted."
dev-exec: Note: we should add a mitigation knob in the control plane for rerank throttles to avoid full disable next time.
eva-oncall: I'll keep thread pinned. Will update when schedule reverts or if any manual rollback happens.
incident-bot: REMINDER: scheduled action schedule-7b2 will revert org-qps to 100 at +30m (6129993034).
